title: Priority claim: interleaving structure and mod-2 pattern laws for the pendant-ladder matching-count recurrences - Lean 4 formalized proof + claim note (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority claim of record (not a full paper). Contents: the claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the Lean 4 sources (Lean v4.34.0, mathlib4 v4.34.0 rev 5ed29652; 0 sorry; #print axioms whitelist-checked) and the audit and novelty-search evidence. Results: three integer sequences defined by literal seeds and recurrences - conjecturally the matching counts of the ladder graph P_n box K_2 with one pendant leaf at every 1-based odd column on a uniform rail - are proved to satisfy (1) apend_interleave: for every k, apend(2k)=opend(k) and apend(2k+1)=epend(k), i.e. the full even-lag order-8 recurrence x(n)=16x(n-2)-25x(n-4)+10x(n-6)-x(n-8) is exactly the interleaving of two order-4 subsequences sharing the characteristic polynomial x^4-16x^3+25x^2-10x+1; (2) apend_mod2_period12: apend n mod 2 depends only on n mod 12 (explicit 12-residue pattern); (3) opend_mod2_period6: opend k is odd iff k = 0 or 4 mod 6; (4) epend_mod2_period3: epend k is even iff k = 0 mod 3. Indexing is 0-based with apend n = a(n+1), opend k = a(2k+1), epend k = a(2k+2). Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's C9 exclusivity review included here in full with every zero-hit query: no occupying record found for the main sequence (11 OEIS variant queries) or the even-position subsequence (6 variant queries), with anchor self-proof; BUT the odd-position subsequence coincides with OEIS A386889 (Dresden and Demirkol, 2025-09-04), an occupied record verified by 13-term offset alignment and an isomorphism check - every mention of the odd side in the note carries this fence, and the novelty is strictly limited to the full order-8 recurrence, the even-position subsequence, the interleaving identity and the mod-2 patterns; value tier new sequence / new recurrence (with occupancy warning) - not new mathematics and no blanket 'new sequence' claim. Boundaries stated in the note: equality of the sequences with the matching counts is not kernel-proved (conjecture layer; support is OEIS/literature endorsement plus local exact enumerators, three independent methods, window n<=30; the enumerators themselves are not verified); the recurrences are Berlekamp-Massey fits verified digit-for-digit, not derived; the two mod-2 subsequence laws are stated in their corrected off-by-one-free forms; the older 'alternating attachment is robust' belief is refuted (alternating differs from the uniform-side convention from n=3 on), so the combinatorial reading is fixed to uniform-side; minimality of the periods is supported by data window plus independent recomputation plus a GF(2) factorisation cross-check, not by the kernel; OpenAlex returned one HTTP 429 and the general web layer was unavailable during the review (recorded as unverified, not used as evidence).
